items.summary: CFO recommendation: approve no new revenue or production claims; preserve only the existing allthingsmasonic.com implementation after capacity and site-overlap clearance, and keep the markitdown prototype research-only. Revenue is not sufficient to support ROI or contribution-margin claims: Amazon reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, but all commission is in an aggregate unattributed row. Site-level revenue is therefore $0 attributed, not $0 earned. Contribution margin, portfolio margin, and ROI are not calculable because site attribution is incomplete and infrastructure, hosting, domain, labor, and other direct costs are absent. Minimum measurement: dated site-level revenue by registered tracking ID plus allocated direct costs and labor rates. Do not compare the $10.8396 AI spend recorded on 2026-10-01 with the 2026-09-21 revenue window. AI coverage is only 11 of 38 expected sites; the measured AI spend is $0.1275 per call on average, but cost-to-learn and payback are not calculable without loaded labor cost, complete AI usage, and attributable incremental contribution. Reject star counts and keyword hits as financial evidence.

CFO disposition: retain the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as a capacity-gated implementation only. Its baseline is 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, 0 shipped items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21. Acceptance should measure affiliate clicks and attributable orders; revenue lift, margin lift, ROI, and causal lift remain unproven. Do not admit duplicate work while delivery is 10/10 occupied, 39 improvements await measurement, and 21 requests have failed.

CFO disposition: keep the markitdown work as private research only after capacity clears. The supplied evidence supports feasibility research, not adoption or financial upside: MIT license, 22 keyword hits, 8/8 bounded checks, no dependency installation, and no production access. The stated 2–3 engineering-day estimate is not a cost-to-learn because no loaded labor rate is supplied. Minimum measurement is reviewer-accepted usable drafts per labor hour versus the manual baseline, with loaded labor cost and parser-error/provenance results. No publication, production dependency, spend, or revenue claim is authorized.
